title: The category of graded objects of an abelian category is abelian
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file homology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma states that the category of graded objects of an abelian category is itself abelian (statement lines 4116-4120). The proof is a complete argument: a morphism of graded objects is given by its components, its kernel and cokernel are the graded objects of the componentwise kernels and cokernels (proof lines 4122-4126), and the axiom that coimage and image coincide is inherited degree by degree from the abelian category (proof lines 4127-4129). The non-formal content is the transport of the abelian structure we need to show exists. The claim is H2: a structured argument with each input named.
